_notes: Central Barrens boss + named-rare loot (2026-10-21). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make).

Gaharrz the Drowned.name: Gaharrz's Drowning Trident
Gaharrz the Drowned.flavor_text: The tines are barnacled. The shaft is warm. Do not ask whose hand it was last in.

Gaharrz the Drowned.name: Warlord's Reef-Scale Hauberk
Gaharrz the Drowned.flavor_text: Scales off something large and angry, stitched with kelp-cord. It smells exactly how you think.

Gaharrz the Drowned.name: Cloak of the Forgotten Pools
Gaharrz the Drowned.flavor_text: Pool-water has a way of turning clean the longer you wear it. It will not turn the wearer clean.

Gaharrz the Drowned.name: Mudscale Tide-Shield
Gaharrz the Drowned.flavor_text: Forged in a place with no forge. The dent in the middle is the shape of a prayer.

Rathorian.name: Rathorian's Void-Touched Staff
Rathorian.flavor_text: A twisted bough with a lump of something hungry in the fork. It purrs when it's fed.

Rathorian.name: Dreadmist Cultmaster's Robes
Rathorian.flavor_text: Black cloth, red thread. The thread is not thread.

Rathorian.name: Seal-Cutter's Knife
Rathorian.flavor_text: A ritual knife for opening things that should stay shut.

Rathorian.name: Signet of the Seed
Rathorian.flavor_text: A ring cut from the same stone as the Seal. It whispers when you take it off. It's worse when you don't.

Xelnaz.name: Xelnaz's Rending Fang
Xelnaz.flavor_text: A fang as long as a dagger, set in a hilt of black iron. Something in it is still hungry.

Xelnaz.name: Felhide Stalker's Leggings
Xelnaz.flavor_text: Cut from hide that was never meant to be cut. The seams hiss faintly at night.

Xelnaz.name: Hound-Master's Chain Belt
Xelnaz.flavor_text: Hook-links, heavy as a leash. A leash is what it was.

Xelnaz.name: Brand of the Hound-Lord
Xelnaz.flavor_text: A ring-shaped scar in iron. It is warm. It is always warm.

Old Sunhide.name: Sunhide Hunter's Jerkin
Old Sunhide.flavor_text: Hide the colour of dry grass, cured till it stopped being a giraffe. The spots are still there.

Old Sunhide.name: Hoofbeat Maul
Old Sunhide.flavor_text: A hoof, a haft and a lot of upward momentum.

Old Sunhide.name: Tall-Grass Girdle
Old Sunhide.flavor_text: A belt you can't see in a savannah. Many have tried.

Stormwing the Skyrider.name: Stormwing's Longbow
Stormwing the Skyrider.flavor_text: Strung with thunderhawk sinew. It hums in the rain. Nobody has survived the lightning to explain why.

Stormwing the Skyrider.name: Skyrider's Pinion Spaulders
Stormwing the Skyrider.flavor_text: Flight-feathers over chain. They lift slightly when you lie.

Stormwing the Skyrider.name: Cape of Charged Wings
Stormwing the Skyrider.flavor_text: It stands up on end before a storm, like a cat, or a wizard.

Redrock Matriarch.name: Matriarch's Carapace Pauldrons
Redrock Matriarch.flavor_text: Chitin plate, ridge on ridge. Nothing bites you through it twice.

Redrock Matriarch.name: Redrock Venom-Blade
Redrock Matriarch.flavor_text: The groove along the edge is for the venom. The venom is optional. The edge is not.

Redrock Matriarch.name: Brood-Queen's Clasp
Redrock Matriarch.flavor_text: A tiny pincer holds a tinier gem. Don't think about it.

Queen Skitterwing.name: Skitterwing's Chitin Rod
Queen Skitterwing.flavor_text: A rod of fused chitin with a pulsing grub-sac at the tip. Do not squeeze.

Queen Skitterwing.name: Hivecrown Cowl
Queen Skitterwing.flavor_text: Chitin plates sewn onto hide. Insects stop biting you the day you put it on. That should worry you.

Queen Skitterwing.name: Queen's Amber Signet
Queen Skitterwing.flavor_text: A droplet of old hive-resin, with something inside that remembers being alive.

Maeve the Weeping.name: Staff of the Weeping Pilgrim
Maeve the Weeping.flavor_text: A pilgrim's walking staff, still walking. The tip is always damp.

Maeve the Weeping.name: Pool-Sodden Pilgrim's Skirt
Maeve the Weeping.flavor_text: Heavy with prayer and forty years of water. It dries when someone is healed.

Maeve the Weeping.name: Wristbands of Unanswered Prayers
Maeve the Weeping.flavor_text: Mail links stamped with names. All of them were asking for the same thing.

Maeve the Weeping.name: Tear of the Forgotten Pool
Maeve the Weeping.flavor_text: A teardrop of pool-glass on a leather cord. It rings softly when something nearby is sad.

Hollowhorn.name: Hollowhorn's Gravetusk Cleaver
Hollowhorn.flavor_text: A kodo tusk split lengthwise, ground to an edge. It remembers the herd.

Hollowhorn.name: Boneyard Plate Leggings
Hollowhorn.flavor_text: Kodo ribs, riveted and lacquered. They creak the way graveyard gates do.

Hollowhorn.name: Herd-Memory Pendant
Hollowhorn.flavor_text: A small carved kodo on a cord. It is heavier than it looks, and it is not heavy.

Warbringer Gorrak.name: Gorrak's Warbringer Lance
Warbringer Gorrak.flavor_text: A centaur's lance, cut for a man's hand. It is still lopsided, because he is not.

Warbringer Gorrak.name: Kolkar Warlord's Hauberk
Warbringer Gorrak.flavor_text: Hide, bone and brass bolted over mail. It reads like a banner if you stand far enough away.

Warbringer Gorrak.name: Helm of the Hoofed Horde
Warbringer Gorrak.flavor_text: A bull-skull helm with the horns sawed off to fit a doorway.

Warbringer Gorrak.name: Warbringer's Rallying Band
Warbringer Gorrak.flavor_text: A warlord's ring. Armies were raised on it. None of them were polite.

Silas Quickfinger.name: Quickfinger's Lamp-Oil Stiletto
Silas Quickfinger.flavor_text: Thin as a rumor. It slides in so fast you don't notice till later.

Silas Quickfinger.name: Gloves of Light Pockets
Silas Quickfinger.flavor_text: Your coin purse will remember them. It just won't be able to prove anything.

Silas Quickfinger.name: Quickfinger's Smuggled Pistol
Silas Quickfinger.flavor_text: Bought from a man who didn't have a stall. Fires like it's late for something.

Silas Quickfinger.name: Charm of the Third Pocket
Silas Quickfinger.flavor_text: A tiny silver lock. Open it and there's another lock. Silas thinks it's funny.

Wardchief Thulg.name: Thulg's Boarhide Cleaver
Wardchief Thulg.flavor_text: A quilboar's idea of an axe: wide, heavy and deeply insulted.

Wardchief Thulg.name: Wardchief's Thorn-Tied Boots
Wardchief Thulg.flavor_text: Boar-hide wrapped around thorn-wood soles. Hurts to step on. Hurts more to be stepped on.

Wardchief Thulg.name: Razormane Thorn Bulwark
Wardchief Thulg.flavor_text: A shield of woven thorn. Yes, it hurts to hold. That is the design.

Sow-Mother Grunka.name: Sow-Mother's Brood-Bell
Sow-Mother Grunka.flavor_text: A bone bell, struck to call the brood. The brood has stopped answering. Interesting.

Sow-Mother Grunka.name: Bristle-Woven Bracers
Sow-Mother Grunka.flavor_text: Boar bristle, braided into a bracer. It is much more comfortable than it sounds.

Sow-Mother Grunka.name: Mantle of the Brood-Mother
Sow-Mother Grunka.flavor_text: A cloak of sow-hide. It's gentler than its wearer was, which is to say not much.

Voidcaller Veshra.name: Veshra's Rift-Whisper Wand
Voidcaller Veshra.flavor_text: A wand carved from a bone nobody asked about. It whispers at night.

Voidcaller Veshra.name: Voidcaller's Cowl
Voidcaller Veshra.flavor_text: Black cloth, red lining. Peering into it is how the lining got red.

Voidcaller Veshra.name: Hollow Ward Signet
Voidcaller Veshra.flavor_text: The stone is empty. The emptiness is the point.

Echo of the Fallen Warrior.name: Fallen Warrior's Echo-Blade
Echo of the Fallen Warrior.flavor_text: A spirit-forged sword from a shrine that doesn't remember its name. The edge does.

Echo of the Fallen Warrior.name: Vambraces of Valour Remembered
Echo of the Fallen Warrior.flavor_text: Plate vambraces that carry the weight of a battle no one was alive to finish.

Echo of the Fallen Warrior.name: Shrine-Keeper's Amulet
Echo of the Fallen Warrior.flavor_text: A small, quiet stone on a leather cord. Wearing it feels a little like being forgiven.

Looter-Chief Bazz.name: Bazz's Stolen Pitchfork
Looter-Chief Bazz.flavor_text: Three tines, one of them bent. It was stolen from a farm, and it knows it.

Looter-Chief Bazz.name: Looter's Padded Vest
Looter-Chief Bazz.flavor_text: Layers of stolen cloth, sewn with prejudice. There's an extra pocket for everything.

Looter-Chief Bazz.name: Scrap-Iron Signet
Looter-Chief Bazz.flavor_text: A ring made of whatever Bazz had in his pockets. Somehow it's stylish.
